id: title:haacked:make the python client retry transient grpc errors

review.posthog_relevance: Changes the retry behavior of the PersonHog client, potentially affecting reliability and performance, though exact impact is unverified.
review.reason: The implementation of the retry interceptor is changed from catching exceptions to inspecting the outcome of the continuation. The old pattern raised an exception, while the new pattern returns an outcome object. This is a significant change in behavior and implementation.
review.uncertainty: This chunk does not include the complete implementation of the new behavior. P1.F1.H3 shows the removal of the exception-raising pattern and replacement with an outcome-returning pattern, but P1.F1.H3 also removes the entire try/except block and the subsequent retry loop, replacing it with a new flow. P1.F2.H14 adds a new test class TestRetryInterceptorOnRealChannel and a new g.
